# Vendored: bambu-headless

Source: https://github.com/danielyaa5/bambu-headless (AGPL-3.0, see LICENSE).
Copied unmodified so this project can send signed control commands through the
user's own installed Bambu Studio networking plugin.

Upstream README, docs and tests are not vendored; see the repository. The
compiled `h2d_network_bridge` binary and `h2d_host_identity.dylib` are built on
first use by upstream's own code and are git-ignored here.
